name: starlight-media-excellence
description: Evidence-led production, independent critique, durable handoffs and release discipline for cross-format premium media. Skills only; no autonomous server or publishing permissions.

interface.longDescription: Direct, produce, review and hand off evidence-backed demonstrations, animated infographics, screenshots, carousels, social videos and DAM-ready media with exact release receipts. This is a skills-only production contract; tools and execution depend on the active host. Includes an inspectable, locally renderable reference pack and negative integrity fixtures.
defaultPrompt: Turn this real product flow into a premium media pack with evidence and final QA.
Critique this video, infographic or carousel for premium release quality.
Continue a media campaign from its artifact handoff and identify the next verified gate.
